title_en: Births and deaths in Andhra Pradesh
why_it_matters_en: People hear claims that more mothers and babies are dying, or that deaths were hidden in some year. This shows the registered births and deaths, district by district, next to the national survey rates for infant and maternal deaths.
why_it_matters_te: తల్లులు, పిల్లల మరణాలు పెరిగాయని లేదా ఒక సంవత్సరంలో మరణాలు దాచారని వింటుంటాం. నమోదైన జననాలు, మరణాలు జిల్లాల వారీగా, జాతీయ సర్వే రేట్లతో పాటు ఇక్కడ చూడవచ్చు.

caveats_en: These are events REGISTERED in the year by place of occurrence, not all events that happened. A child born in a Hyderabad or Chennai hospital is registered there, not in AP.
Calendar year (1 January to 31 December). The 2014 figures are for the 13-district state, as printed in the 2014 report.
Registration can be delayed. A report counts what was registered in that year, including some late registrations of earlier events.

2016: the report prints 451023 male and 363731 female registered births for AP, which gives the very low sex ratio 806 it prints that year. Kept as printed; it looks like a reporting problem in the source.
2024: male plus female does not equal the person total as printed for AP, and the report's note on 'Others/Not Stated' does not list AP. The person total is used.
caveats_te: ఇవి ఆ సంవత్సరంలో నమోదైన సంఘటనలు మాత్రమే, జరిగిన అన్నీ కాదు. ఘటన జరిగిన చోటనే నమోదవుతుంది. ఉదాహరణకు హైదరాబాద్ లేదా చెన్నై ఆసుపత్రిలో పుట్టిన బిడ్డ అక్కడే నమోదవుతుంది.
క్యాలెండర్ సంవత్సరం (జనవరి 1 నుంచి డిసెంబర్ 31). 2014 అంకెలు 13 జిల్లాల రాష్ట్రానికి, 2014 నివేదికలో ఉన్నట్లే.
నమోదు ఆలస్యం కావచ్చు. ఆ ఏడాది నమోదైనవన్నీ లెక్కలో ఉంటాయి, అందులో పాత సంఘటనల ఆలస్య నమోదు కూడా ఉండవచ్చు.
2016లో మగ, ఆడ జననాల అంకెలు అసాధారణంగా ఉన్నాయి (మూలంలో ఉన్నట్లే ఉంచాం).
2024లో మగ + ఆడ కలిపితే మొత్తం రాదు. మొత్తం (person) అంకెనే వాడాం.

Calendar year (1 January to 31 December). The 2014 figures are for the 13-district state, as printed in the 2014 report.
Registration can be delayed. A report counts what was registered in that year, including some late registrations of earlier events.

Registered infant deaths in AP are far below what the survey-based infant mortality rate implies. Rural infant deaths are especially thin (12 in all rural AP in 2014). Use the SRS infant mortality rate series for the real level; use this one only to see what gets registered.

caveats_en: District names are exactly as printed (for example 'Ananthapur', 'Cuddapah', 'Prakasham', 'Ysr Kadapa' and 'YSR Kadapa' in different tables of the same year).
Events are counted in the district where they were registered. Big hospital towns (Guntur, Kurnool, Visakhapatnam, Tirupati) take in births and deaths from nearby districts.
The source also prints rural/urban and male/female columns for each district; only the person total is kept here.
2014 to 2021 reports use the 13-district map, even for 2021.
caveats_te: జిల్లా పేర్లు మూలంలో ఉన్నట్లే ఉంచాం.
సంఘటన నమోదైన జిల్లాలోనే లెక్కిస్తారు. పెద్ద ఆసుపత్రులు ఉన్న పట్టణాల జిల్లాల్లో పక్క జిల్లాల జననాలు, మరణాలు కూడా కలుస్తాయి.

refresh.how: CRS report: GET https://dc.crsorgi.gov.in/assets/download/Annual-Reports/crs/<YEAR>.pdf (2025 report expected mid 2027). MCCD: same path with /mccd/<YEAR>.pdf. SRS rates: RBI Handbook of Statistics on Indian States, https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/AnnualPublications.aspx?head=Handbook+of+Statistics+on+Indian+States (Tables 2-5), or the SRS bulletin on censusindia.gov.in when reachable.
refresh.cadence: yearly; CRS and MCCD reports come about 1.5 years after the calendar year; RBI Handbook each December
refresh.notes: CRS and MCCD are PDFs; parse with pdftotext -layout. The 2017 CRS report has no text layer (Type 3 fonts). Use the CA bundle that includes the emSign roots for dc.crsorgi.gov.in. RBI pages render the table in HTML; rbidocs XLSX links gave an empty reply today.

blocked.would_have_given: AP's own CRS annual reports: institutional vs domiciliary births and deaths, maternal deaths if printed, district tables in the state's own format. The site's *.ap.gov.in certificate expired on 20 Oct 2026 23:59:59 GMT; it was readable on 19 Oct. Plain http answers, but that would skip the certificate check, so it was not used.

SRS bulletins and SRS Statistical Reports (single-year AP birth, death and infant mortality rates, rural/urban split, 2024 values), and the original Vital Statistics catalogue pages. The server sends an incomplete certificate chain (missing emSign SSL CA - G1); the AIA download of the intermediate from repository.emsign.com was reset.
Mirror of SRS bulletin PDFs (CONNECT tunnel 502).
Machine-readable copies of the same RBI tables (empty reply from server). The HTML table pages were used instead.

Failures: []

checks.what: 2017 report (no text layer) transcribed from page images
checks.how: Read PDF pages 73-77, 85, 98, 111, 124, 49, 50, 65 as images. All 56 transcribed rows pass male+female=person, rural+urban=total; the 13 district rows add up to the printed AP row in all 9 columns; 2017 totals match the 2024 report's multi-year statements (818165, 355546, 9115). Tesseract OCR of the same pages agrees on the AP state rows where the OCR is legible.
Each Statement 2.4 prints three years; every overlapping AP value (registered, certified, %) is the same in consecutive reports 2014-2024, and the 2024 Statement 2.11 percentages for 2015-2024 match.

checks.how: Rendered 2022 Table 7 (deaths by district, PDF page 103) as an image and compared all 26 AP district totals with the dataset: all equal.

checks.what: Sex ratio 2017-2023 identical in 2021, 2022, 2023 and 2024 reports

checks.how: 2019, 2023 and 2024 reports print the same revised AP values for 2014-2019; first-print values (2014-2018 Table 5) differ and are kept as a separate series.

gaps: Institutional vs home births and deaths for AP: the national CRS report prints this only for India; AP's own CRS report on hmfw.ap.gov.in is blocked today (expired certificate).
Maternal deaths as a count: neither the CRS nor the MCCD report prints an AP count of maternal deaths in the tables read. Only the SRS maternal mortality ratio (three-year windows) is shown.
SRS rates stop at 2023 (RBI Handbook 2024-25). Any 2024 SRS values could not be checked because censusindia.gov.in is blocked.
No district-level SRS rates exist; district figures are registrations only, counted where the event was registered.
No report on the 28-district map yet. Newest district data (2024) uses 26 districts.
Level of registration is not printed for 2020, 2021 and 2022.
Registered infant deaths and still births are badly under-registered in AP; their district numbers should not be read as real death levels.
Cause-of-death detail by state (MCCD Statement 3.6, nine cause groups) is printed as percentages only; not loaded here.
